guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Open the GRVT reward portal
guide.description: Sign in at the GRVT website and go to the reward portal with the exact account you traded with during Season 1 or Season 2. Allocations are tied to that account, so use the same email and wallet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check your allocation
guide.description: The checker is live. Your $GRVT figure reflects your combined points from both seasons, adjusted for any Multiplier Plan you locked in before the July 17 cutoff.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Confirm how your first tranche arrives
guide.description: If you registered before July 17 and selected a destination, your first tranche is sent automatically. Tokens routed to your GRVT account land immediately at the TGE; external BSC or Ethereum wallets can take up to 30 minutes because of network congestion.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim manually if you registered after July 17
guide.description: Later registrants claim through the reward portal instead. Locate your unlocked batch, click Claim, and the $GRVT is credited to your GRVT account once confirmed. If several batches are unlocked, claim each one individually.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim each remaining tranche over the next 12 months
guide.description: Standard plan tokens keep unlocking in batches across the year. Multiplier Plan distributions begin at Month 4 (2x) or Month 8 (4x). Each unlocked batch has a 30 day claim window with no exceptions afterward, so set a reminder ahead of every unlock date.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
